name: wes-anderson
description: Wes Anderson: faded matte film, soft flat contrast, dusty muted pastels, teal-leaning greens and blues.
notes: From Imagen's Wes Anderson Lightroom style guide. Where it gives a range this uses the middle; its colour grading hues are named, not numbered ('bluish-teal' shadows, 'pale yellow or light orange' highlights), so those are 190 and 45. It also nudges Calibration (Blue Primary hue -15, Red and Blue Primary saturation +5 to +10), which looks has no slider for. Best on symmetrical, evenly lit scenes: buildings, interiors, storefronts.
author: Imagen
